appearances.whereabouts: in a hollow near the River Arinelle, then searching downriver on foot, then in a clearing with Moiraine and Lan
appearances.notable_actions: wakes after sleeping through the night; searches for tracks of the others along the riverbank; discovers Moiraine and Lan's camp; hides and eavesdrops on their conversation; confronts Moiraine about her plans; learns she can channel the One Power; reluctantly accepts this truth; agrees to travel south with them to find the boys
appearances.demeanor: initially alert and self-reproachful for falling asleep; determined and focused while tracking; angry and defensive when confronting Moiraine; shaken and horrified when learning about her Power; torn and grief-stricken when forced to choose between searching for Egwene and helping the boys; stubborn and proud throughout, refusing to back down or show weakness
alliances_shown: protective of Egwene and the Emond's Field boys
antagonistic toward Moiraine but forced into cooperation

appearances.whereabouts: in a clearing by the River Arinelle with a campfire
appearances.notable_actions: makes tea; discusses the situation with Lan; senses Nynaeve hiding and calls her out; reveals to Nynaeve that she can channel; explains how she detected this ability; explains the danger of untrained channeling; reveals she gave tokens to the boys to track them; explains one boy is across the river, two went downriver; decides to head south; prepares to depart
appearances.demeanor: calm, confident, patient, strategic, matter-of-fact when delivering difficult truths; shows slight frustration about the separation but maintains composure; sympathetic but firm with Nynaeve
alliances_shown: opposes the Dark One and anything he wants
faces opposition within the White Tower

appearances.whereabouts: returns to Moiraine's camp from scouting, then in the clearing preparing to depart

appearances.demeanor: grim when reporting; professionally detached; protective of Moiraine; expressionless and stoic; efficient in his movements; shows brief surprise when learning about Nynaeve's ability

relationships.description: Moiraine is Aes Sedai who holds the Warder bond with Lan
Mistress Barran was the previous Wisdom who trained Nynaeve as her apprentice
Nynaeve looked after Egwene as a toddler and healed her of breakbone fever; sees her as special and potential Wisdom successor; deeply protective of her
Nynaeve is hostile and antagonistic toward Moiraine, resenting her Aes Sedai plans and influence over the Emond's Field folk, but forced into reluctant cooperation
Moiraine wants to train Egwene at the White Tower; believes she has potential to become one of the most powerful Aes Sedai in centuries
Moiraine gave Rand a token creating a bond to track him; seeks to protect him from the Dark One
